probe_assessment: The cold read mostly held up. The purpose and public API descriptions match the module, including the default clean-then-fine flow, BERTScore use, GPU-only WhisperX behaviour, and cleanup. The capability assignment stumble is model error: capability deliberately carries either the 'unavailable' sentinel or the device capability tuple for logging, while arch is derived separately. The _score_pending stumble is genuine: the code consumes a marker inside an OR expression and restores it on the next line, so the marker lifecycle and the reason newly cleaned text supersedes an existing score require tracing. The hallucination_silence_threshold stumble is genuine: the module names the WhisperX setting and points to an external settings proposal, but does not explain its effect or why 2.0 is used. No other material probe misreading was found.
